title: Apollo lunar dust in Charles's lab and lunar retroreflectors

tellings.quote: I have a 200 gram or so in my lab.

plain: About 200 grams of Moon dust from the Apollo missions, NASA's Moon landings of 1969 to 1972, sits in his own lab, says Charles Buhler, a NASA scientist. He tells it first-hand. The conversation also turns to the retroreflectors, mirrors the astronauts left on the Moon that bounce laser light back to Earth, as physical traces of those landings.
